business_summary: Persistence Resources Group Ltd, an investment holding company, engages in the exploration, mining, processing, and sale of gold bullion derived from gold concentrate in the People's Republic of China. It holds 75% interest in the Songjiagou Open-Pit Mine and the Songjiagou Underground Mine located in Songjiagou. Persistence Resources Group Ltd was formerly known as SINOGOLD Resources Holdings Group Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Persistence Resources Group Ltd in May 2022. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Sheung Wan, Hong Kong. Persistence Resources Group Ltd operates as a subsidiary of Majestic Gold Corp.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Persistence Resources Group Ltd는 중화인민공화국의 금 정광에서 파생된 금괴의 탐사, 채굴, 가공 및 판매에 종사합니다. 송가구 노천광산과 송가구 지하광산의 지분 75%를 보유하고 있다. Persistence Resources Group Ltd는 이전에 SINOGOLD Resources Holdings Group Co., Ltd.로 알려졌으며 2022년 5월에 Persistence Resources Group Ltd로 이름을 변경했습니다. 이 회사는 2005년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 셩완에 본사를 두고 있습니다. Persistence Resources Group Ltd는 Majestic Gold Corp의 자회사로 운영됩니다.
